{{/* Renders a page's author list, truncated to `.max` authors + "et al." when there are more than that — while always keeping the site owner's own name visible (and bold) even if they'd otherwise fall outside the truncated group. Note: this does NOT delegate to the stock `page_metadata_authors` partial even for short lists. Author names in citations (e.g. "M. Fournier") resolve to an auto-generated taxonomy term page, not the real profile page at content/authors/admin, so `.Page.Params.*` lookups used by the stock partial's bold-highlighting never resolve — every author, including the site owner, always rendered unbolded. We match by surname instead: fetch the site owner's `last_name` param from their real profile (same technique site_head.html uses, via `Params.superuser`) and find the author term whose name contains it. */}} {{ $item := .item }} {{ $max := .max | default 3 }} {{ $authors := $item.GetTerms "authors" }} {{ $total := len $authors }} {{ $owner_lastname := "" }} {{ range first 1 (where (where site.Pages "Section" "authors") "Params.superuser" true) }} {{ $owner_lastname = .Params.last_name }} {{ end }} {{ $owner := "" }} {{ if $owner_lastname }} {{ range $authors }} {{ if strings.Contains .LinkTitle $owner_lastname }}{{ $owner = . }}{{ end }} {{ end }} {{ end }} {{ $shown := $authors }} {{ $truncated := gt $total $max }} {{ if $truncated }} {{ $shown = first $max $authors }} {{ end }} {{ $owner_shown := false }} {{ range $shown }} {{ if and $owner (eq .RelPermalink $owner.RelPermalink) }}{{ $owner_shown = true }}{{ end }} {{ end }} {{ range $index, $value := $shown }} {{- if gt $index 0 }}, {{ end -}} {{- if .RelPermalink -}} {{ .LinkTitle }} {{- else -}} {{ .LinkTitle }} {{- end -}} {{- end -}} {{- if and $truncated $owner (not $owner_shown) -}} , {{- if $owner.RelPermalink -}} {{ $owner.LinkTitle }} {{- else -}} {{ $owner.LinkTitle }} {{- end -}} {{- end -}} {{- if $truncated }}, et al.{{ end -}}
